## Load libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

## Load data

```{r}
data_dir <- here("data")
clean_df <- readr::read_tsv(file = file.path(data_dir,
                                             "01_dat_load.tsv.gz"), 
                            col_names = TRUE,     
                            show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Clean data

```{r}
clean_df <- clean_df |>   
  drop_na(gene_name) |>   
  mutate(sample_id = basename(dirname(file))) |>   
  select(c("sample_id",             
           "gene_id",             
           "gene_name",             
           "gene_type",             
           "unstranded"))
```

## Write data file

```{r}
readr::write_tsv(clean_df,
                 file.path(data_dir, 
                           "02_dat_clean.tsv.gz"))
```
